Description: Damian Maseko enters Edmund Galley’s room alone to search for the pocket watch. After calling out repeatedly with no response, he moves further in and feels around briefly, then leaves upon hearing piano music outside, implying he discovers something abnormal here.
Location: Edmund Galley’s room (Edmund's room)
Key Information:
  - Damian Maseko enters Edmund Galley’s room (Edmund's room) alone.
  - Damian Maseko repeatedly calls out politely to the woman in the room, hoping to ask about the pocket watch’s whereabouts, but receives no response.
  - Damian Maseko proceeds further inside and performs a brief tactile search, indicating he is verifying the room’s situation by touch.
  - With no reply at all, Damian Maseko stops moving.
  - Piano music is heard outside the room, and Damian Maseko immediately leaves.
  - Later nodes confirm that Damian Maseko is in fact confirming in this node that Person No. 10 Eve Dauer has died, which explains why he clearly knows her death as a fact afterward.
Characters:
  [Damian Maseko (Damian Maseko)] Person No. 8.
    · Enters Edmund Galley’s room to search for the pocket watch.
    · Calls out repeatedly to the woman inside but receives no response.
    · Feels around in the room and confirms something abnormal.
    · After leaving this room, clearly knows Eve Dauer’s death as a fact.
  [Eve Dauer (Eve Dauer)] Person No. 10, confirmed deceased.
    · Was previously settled to rest in Edmund Galley’s room.
    · Provides no response at the time corresponding to this node.
    · Her death state is explicitly confirmed in later nodes.
